reviewNotes: Twenty-five object strings covering crops, fencing, minerals, geodes, fish, ginger products, and legendary fish were translated directly from English. Two full editorial audits cover crop timing, resource yields, equipment placement, established fish names, mineral descriptions, item gender, and approved glossary terminology; both found no remaining objective issue.

Garlic_Description.source: Adds a wonderful zestiness to dishes. High quality garlic can be pretty spicy.
Garlic_Description.translation: Dă preparatelor o iuțeală minunată. Usturoiul de calitate superioară poate fi destul de iute.

GarlicSeeds_Description.source: Plant these in the spring. Takes 4 days to mature.
GarlicSeeds_Description.translation: Plantează-le primăvara. Ajung la maturitate în 4 zile.

Gate_Description.source: Allows you to pass through a fence.
Gate_Description.translation: Îți permite să treci printr-un gard.

GemStone_Description.source: Break apart to obtain stone, ores, or geodes.
GemStone_Description.translation: Sparge-o pentru a obține piatră, minereuri sau geode.

Geode_Description.source: A blacksmith can break this open for you.
Geode_Description.translation: Un fierar o poate sparge pentru tine.

GhostCrystal_Description.source: There is an aura of coldness around this crystal.
GhostCrystal_Description.translation: Acest cristal este înconjurat de o aură rece.

Ghostfish_Description.source: A pale, blind fish found in underground lakes.
Ghostfish_Description.translation: Un pește palid și orb, întâlnit în lacurile subterane.

Ginger_Description.source: This sharp, spicy root is said to increase vitality.
Ginger_Description.translation: Se spune că această rădăcină aromată și iute sporește vitalitatea.

GingerAle_Description.source: A zesty soda known for its soothing effect on the stomach.
GingerAle_Description.translation: O băutură carbogazoasă aromată, cunoscută pentru efectul liniștitor asupra stomacului.

Glacierfish_Description.source: Builds a nest on the underside of glaciers.
Glacierfish_Description.translation: Își construiește cuibul pe partea inferioară a ghețarilor.

GlacierfishJr_Description.source: The original Glacierfish had a son...
GlacierfishJr_Description.translation: Peștele-ghețar original a avut un fiu...
